purpose.statement: Make labels a strong, enforced authoring contract and carry their value through search, related content, browse, Studio, web, CLI, and SDK reads.
purpose.why: The larger Barkpark goal is a corpus people and agents can navigate with confidence. Unlabeled or weakly labeled documents undermine findability, but a publish wall alone would burden authors without paying readers back. Sequencing validation, registry, deduplication, ranking, related reads, browse, and surface parity was the right intervention because isolated enforcement would create friction without discovery. If omitted, corpus growth would continue producing content that exists but cannot be reliably found or related.
